Codex review: blocked before merge. _Reviewed September 9, 2026, 5:18 PM ET / 21:18 UTC (Revision 35)._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes Adds dedicated installed-plugin settings pages for schema-backed configuration, access inspection, and lifecycle actions, replacing overlapping administration views. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 6 items remain** Keep open: this remains useful, protected work that current main does not replace. Both previous P2 findings remain in the reviewed head; earlier host-control and editor-remount concerns are addressed. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `9f88dee44b72515ce17312832c5aa284d15294cd` **Owner decision:** Required. See [Decision needed](#decision-needed). ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Useful consolidation with visible UI proof, but two persistent correctness defects prevent merge readiness. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected before/after screenshots demonstrate the dedicated plugin detail presentation, breadcrumbs, switch, access summaries, and lifecycle layout. This preserves the visual proof assessment; it does not establish recovery, post-save grant freshness, or upgrade preservation, which remain separate repair and validation requirements. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 2 actionable review findings remain. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Verified | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected before/after screenshots demonstrate the dedicated plugin detail presentation, breadcrumbs, switch, access summaries, and lifecycle layout. This preserves the visual proof assessment; it does not establish recovery, post-save grant freshness, or upgrade preservation, which remain separate repair and validation requirements. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 10 items | Pinned patch and live identity: The introduced comparison is 613b06f9e4312c956f7df16a21ec94e6596a30b5..9f88dee44b72515ce17312832c5aa284d15294cd. GitHub REST confirmed the PR remains open at that head. The supplied test merge is stale and was not used to infer removals from main.
